stemMd: A paragraph argues that evening opening hours make a public workshop more accessible to residents who work during the day. Which example belongs in it?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A bus driver now attends a repair class after finishing her afternoon shift.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The workshop owns three kinds of saw.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A retired resident prefers the morning session.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The building has a brick facade.

explanationMd: An example should match both the group and the benefit in the claim. A worker attending after a shift demonstrates access created by evening scheduling.

distractorRationale.b: An equipment list does not show increased access for daytime workers.
distractorRationale.d: Appearance does not address scheduling access.
distractorRationale.c: This example concerns someone whose access is not improved by evening hours.
